name: refactor_ts_promise_chain_to_async_await
description: Refactors a TS .then/.catch promise chain to async/await while preserving the error-fallback behavior
prompts: displayName in user_loader.ts is written as a promise chain: fetchUser(id).then(user => user.name).then(name => name.toUpperCase()).catch(() => "guest"). Refactor it to async/await style: declare it async, await fetchUser, and use try/catch for the fallback. The observable behavior must be identical - a known id resolves to the upper-cased name, and an UNKNOWN id still resolves to "guest" (it must not reject). The refactored file must contain no .then( or .catch( calls. Do not change fetchUser or the USERS data.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit user_loader.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build user_loader.ts
node behavior_test.js
